hypothesis.question: Can independent fixed-plan consequence analysis expose operational fragility missed by nominal validity and preserve an auditable observation-to-review workflow?
hypothesis.test: Hold submitted production fixed; apply identical demand, production-loss, outage and starting-water conditions to reference and competent flat control. Link only explicitly mapped readings known at the declared review cutoff.
falsifiers: Zero-disturbance replay fails to reproduce retained water trajectories.
Mass balance fails when demand cannot be served or storage overflows.
Different plans receive different external conditions.
Later readings affect an earlier review.
Changes in tank size are credited without exposing changed initial water.
hypothesis.limits: No replacement forecast or scheduler. Physical validity is restricted to declared uniform hourly water flows; there is no grid allocation, salinity, ramp or drinking-water quality validation.
